changes: Setup and Portable check this repository stable public GitHub Releases, after 45 seconds and every six hours. Automatic downloads wait until the overlay is idle and are capped at 2 MiB/s.

Before staging/installing, verify exact x64 asset name, pinned HTTPS hosts, size and SHA256 from the GitHub asset digest. Refuse prereleases, drafts, downgrades, mismatched hashes and untrusted redirects.

Install only after an explicit Restart and install action. The independent hidden Windows helper pins/waits for the main process, then runs Setup or replaces the original Portable path. Portable keeps its backup until a verified new startup and restarts the old EXE if staging changed. Timed-out helper launch is cancelled.

The automatic preference, check/download/install controls and status are shared by settings, tray and overlay. Offline advice continues normally; game data is never part of update GET requests. Unpacked development builds are not replaced.
Local Start-Overlay prefers the Portable EXE, allowing later self-updates to preserve its launch path. Versions before 1.0.3 require one manual update.
limitations: Update metadata and binaries are trusted through this GitHub repository over HTTPS and SHA256, not a separate Authenticode signing certificate.

Setup flags are verified with a harmless Windows probe and the real installer payload is extracted/compared/launched; tests do not install over the user application or modify registry installation state.

Portable replacement, backup cleanup, changed-staging recovery, Unicode/special paths and helper survival after host exit are tested on owned probe executables. Packaged update networking/UI uses only a loopback fake release; the fake update is not executed.
Checks/downloads are automatic; installation requires the user action and does not interrupt a run.
